title: 07 MONO CLASS-D AUDIO OUTPUT 3W
purpose: Mono Class-D audio amplifier: one MAX98357A (U6) with VDD/PVDD on the 5 V boost rail (VBUS_BOOST) so it can deliver up to 3.2 W into 4 ohm; speaker connected by two solder pads J3 (SPK+ / SPK-). 12 dB gain, integrated thermal and over-current protection. Rev B client change: second channel removed, JST connector replaced by solder pads.

parts.role: Mono Class-D Audio Amplifier (PVDD = 5 V boost rail)
Speaker solder pads SPK+ / SPK- (3.5 mm pitch wire pads; speaker >= 3 W rated, 4 ohm)
10uF bulk decoupling capacitor on U6 VDD (VBUS_BOOST 5 V rail)
100nF high-frequency bypass capacitor on U6 VDD (VBUS_BOOST 5 V rail)

qa.item: Class-D output power at 5 V PVDD
qa.formula: MAX98357A datasheet: P_OUT = 3.2 W into 4 ohm at PVDD = 5 V, THD+N = 10 %; 2.6 W at 1 % THD+N
qa.result: Meets the client's 3 W mono requirement with the amplifier fed from VBUS_BOOST (5.0 V). On VSYS (3.3-4.2 V) the same part gives only 1.4-2.2 W, hence the rail change. Speaker must be rated >= 3 W, 4 ohm (MPN to be confirmed by client; previous OWS-142550TA-4 is 2 W).
qa.source: Analog Devices MAX98357A datasheet, Electrical Characteristics (Output Power, PVDD = 5 V, RL = 4 ohm)

qa.formula: GAIN_SLOT (pin 2) connected to GND -> 12 dB gain
qa.result: 12 dB gain from the ESP32-S3 I2S stream; full-scale digital input reaches 3 W at 5 V PVDD.

qa.formula: C19 10 uF + C20 100 nF at VDD pins 7/8
qa.result: Datasheet-recommended 10 uF bulk plus 0.1 uF local bypass on VDD; VBUS_BOOST also carries C11/C12 (2x10 uF) at the boost output.
